## Purpose
The cleanup package (Settings → Cleanup). It deletes what the platform has accumulated, by area or all of it, and restores a fresh-install state: the built-in seeds are restored, and the predefined native tools and the platform's own agents are kept.

## Responsibilities
Re-exports `TARGETS`, `preview` and `run` from `targets`.
